hero.subheadline: Character-driven animated films screened at Berlin festival 2027
hero.valueProposition: Selected character-driven animated short films are screened to festival audiences at the 23rd Pictoplasma Berlin festival in May 2027, with no submission fee.

content.whyJoin:
Pictoplasma is a well-established platform for contemporary character design and art, and its annual Berlin festival is a meeting point for the international character design and animation scene. The Characters In Motion program screens a curated selection of international animations, short films, motion graphics, and experimental work focused on stylish, character-driven visuals and narratives.

Films selected for the official program are shown to festival audiences in Berlin in May 2027, giving animators international exposure within a community of character designers, illustrators, and animation creators. The screenings are part of the wider festival, which also includes exhibitions across the city, artist talks, and industry events.

Submission is free of charge and open at any time, so there is no cost pressure. Entries are reviewed by a jury that selects work true to the spirit of Pictoplasma, making this a credible route to festival recognition for character-focused animators.
content.whoShouldApply:
This call is for animators and creators worldwide aged 18 and above working in character-driven animation. Eligible works include experimental, narrative, non-narrative, commissioned, and student films, as well as music videos and motion graphics, typically between 1 and 15 minutes long.

It suits individual animators, students, and studios whose work centers on characters and fresh visual storytelling. The festival is oriented toward a professional and enthusiast audience for character design and art, so work should be visually distinctive and character-focused rather than generic motion graphics.

faq.question: Is there a submission fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no submission fee for the Pictoplasma animation festival, and submissions can be made at any time.

faq.question: Who can submit and what length should a film be?
faq.answer: Creators aged 18 and above from any part of the world can submit. The average length of animation entries considered for the official selection is between 1 and 15 minutes.

faq.question: What kinds of work are eligible?
faq.answer: Character-driven animated short films, music videos, and experimental work are eligible, including experimental, narrative, non-narrative, commissioned, and student films.

faq.question: What is the deadline for the 2027 edition?
faq.answer: Films submitted before January 11, 2027 will be considered for the 23rd Pictoplasma festival selection, which takes place in Berlin in May 2027.

faq.question: How can a filmmaker submit a film?
faq.answer: Provide a downloadable Full HD Quicktime file (ProRes 422 HQ or H.264 codec) via a download link, accompanied by the filled-out entry form, to the Pictoplasma animation submission email or via their WeTransfer page.

faq.question: What does selection involve?
faq.answer: Selected films are screened in the official Characters In Motion program during the Berlin festival. There is no cash prize; the benefit is festival screening and international exposure.

submissionGuide.detail: Have a character-driven animated short, music video, or experimental work between 1 and 15 minutes, exported as a Full HD Quicktime file with ProRes 422 HQ or H.264 codec.
Download and complete the official Pictoplasma animation application form PDF for your film.
Upload your film to a file sharing service and create a downloadable link, either to email to the Pictoplasma submission address or to submit via their WeTransfer page.
Send your film's download link along with the completed entry form before January 11, 2027. There is no submission fee.
A jury reviews eligible submissions. Selected works are included in the official Characters In Motion screening program at the Berlin festival in May 2027.
